units.source_text: 可是，一走进川奈观光旅馆，就坐在大厅里款式新颖的椅子上，

en.t: But as soon as he entered the Kawana sightseeing inn, he sat down on a stylish new chair in the lobby,

units.source_text: 一边歇息一边喝点红茶。

en.t: resting while drinking a little black tea.

units.source_text: 对名人来说，这完全不相称。

en.t: For the Master, this was completely out of keeping.
